title: Review verdict, version 0
description: What a review lens returns for one diff. Written as JSON. Every key is listed here: an unknown key is an error, so a misspelt one fails instead of being ignored. The verdict decides which findings must be present, so a verdict cannot contradict its own findings.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the verdict follows. A reader that does not know the version must refuse the verdict.

lens.description: The lens that reviewed, by name: `rust`, `test-truth`, and so on.

commit.description: The commit the review was pinned to: forty lower-case hexadecimal digits. A verdict about a diff that has since moved says nothing about the new one.

verdict.description: `approved`: no finding blocks. `needs_revision`: at least one finding blocks and the work can be fixed in place. `failed`: the approach or a critical flaw cannot be fixed by revising, so there is at least one P0 finding and the work needs to be planned again.

findings.description: What the review found, blocking or not. Empty when it found nothing.

notes.description: Observations that are not findings: what was done well, alternatives worth raising with a person. Never blocking.

severity.description: `P0`: must not merge in any form: a critical flaw, a required item missing, or an approach that cannot be revised into shape. `P1`: must be fixed before merge. `P2`: should be fixed; blocks only if the lens says so. `P3`: a nit.

blocking.description: Whether this finding stops the change from being approved. A P0 finding always blocks.

axis.description: Which of the lens's axes the finding belongs to, by the lens's own name for it.

title.description: What is wrong, in a few words.

evidence.description: What was seen: a file and line, or the output of a command. A finding without evidence is an opinion, and a reader must not act on it.

location.description: Where, when it is one place.

revision.description: What to change. Required for a blocking finding, so that whoever revises is told, not left to guess.
